newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes soft amid dlr speculation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes soft amid dlr speculation.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed a shade lower as speculators pushed up the dollar, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.77 to the dollar after opening at 56.75, lower than its previous closing of 56.63.
"Speculators took the rupee up to 56.93, but there was selling after 56.90," said a Standard Chartered dealer.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by three local cents and fixed buying and selling prices at 56.0513 and 57.1837, respectively.
Overnight call money closed at 16.5 percent after opening at 17, as lenders outnumbered borrowers, dealers said. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
